Class Db

java.lang.Object
Db
public final class Db extends Object
Provides database connection and query helper methods for the Sharetea point-of-sale system.

    • get

      public static Connection get() throws SQLException
      Gets the current database connection. A new connection is created if one does not already exist or if the previous connection is closed.
      Returns:
      an active connection to the PostgreSQL database
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database connection cannot be established

      Runs a SELECT query and converts the results into a read-only table model.
